    # '.user', 'user.', 'user..name', 'user--name' are invalid by this pattern.
    # This pattern ensures the local part starts and ends with an alphanumeric character,
    # and any special characters (._%+- ) are always followed by an alphanumeric character.
    local_part_pattern = r"[a-zA-Z0-9]+(?:[._%+-][a-zA-Z0-9]+)*"

    # Regex for a single domain label (e.g., 'def', 'ghi', 'com').
    # A label must start and end with an alphanumeric character.

    # The maximum length of a domain label is 63 characters (RFC 1035).
    # This pattern allows single-character labels (e.g., 'a.b.com').
    # It matches a character, then optionally a sequence of 0-61 chars (alphanumeric or hyphen)
    # followed by another alphanumeric character. This covers 1 to 63 characters.
    domain_label_pattern = r"[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?"

    tld_pattern = r"[a-zA-Z](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])"
